page: Amazon Web Services m8gn.metal-24xl is a bare-metal server belonging to the general-purpose instance family. Built on custom 64-bit Arm architecture (arm64) using AWS Graviton processors, the platform exposes the underlying hardware directly without an intermediary virtualization hypervisor. The configuration comprises 96 dedicated physical cores clocked at 2.8 GHz, with one hardware thread per core. Memory capacity stands at 384 GB, delivering a 4.0 GB per-core allocation that adheres to the standard general-purpose computing ratio.

In terms of I/O architecture, the server features a baseline network throughput of 300 Gbps, facilitating high-bandwidth inter-node communication. It includes no bundled local storage, requiring persistent data to reside on external Amazon Elastic Block Store volumes or remote network filesystems. Graphics processing hardware is absent, with zero GPUs included. Operating on an energy-efficient Arm design without hypervisor context switching, the platform offers high core density and predictable resource isolation, presenting favorable resource-per-core economics for distributed architectures.

Given its combination of 96 non-hyperthreaded physical cores, direct hardware access, and 300 Gbps networking pipeline, m8gn.metal-24xl is structured for network-intensive backends, multi-tenant container orchestration nodes, distributed microservices, and high-throughput application servers that operate without local scratch disks.
description: Amazon Web Services m8gn.metal-24xl is a bare-metal general-purpose server powered by custom 64-bit Arm-based AWS Graviton processors. The system delivers 96 dedicated physical cores running at a base clock speed of 2.8 GHz, operating with a single thread per core to eliminate hyperthreading contention. It is configured with 384 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 allocation ratio of 4.0 GB RAM per core. Hardware acceleration is absent, with zero GPUs included. Local disk storage is not bundled, making the instance entirely dependent on external Elastic Block Store volumes or remote network filesystems for data persistence. A key hardware feature is its baseline networking throughput of 300 Gbps, enabling rapid data movement across cluster nodes. Without hypervisor virtualization overhead, m8gn.metal-24xl provides predictable computing efficiency for multi-threaded enterprise services, large-scale container platforms, distributed microservices, and network-bound general-purpose cloud workloads.
